name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard covers the commanded key grab. Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard keeps the stated order, since "after that" leads into the goal step and the "if you can" cue covers only the step itself. Existence(at_goal) soft matches the preference. The machine reaches its final state after the key is held and rejects reaching the goal first.

texts: Grab the yellow key: the agent must carry the key at some point.
After grabbing the key, the agent should get to the goal square if it can: the goal must not be reached before the key is held.
If possible, the agent gets to the goal square.
